description.narrative: Stöd till att stärka medborgares engagemenag för ansvarsutkrävande genom att öka tillgång till information i stor skala genom innovativa metoder. Särskild inriktning på ansvarsutkrävande inom sektorerna utbildning, vatten och hälsa.

Support to strengthen citizen agency and action for demanding accountability through increasing access to information in large scale through innovative methods. Special focus on accountability in the sectors: education, water and health.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: For the whole program Sida note deviations from original plans from 2009/2010. The complex and in many regard experimental program aiming at reaching large scale and scope for increased citizen agency and improved service delivery in eduaction, health and water has been adjusted by the organisation, taking into account "what works" and not continuing with interventions not paying off (as outlined in Pivot note from October 2013 and Board decision). The follow-up in 2015 of the baseline survey of citizen action from 2010/2011 is showing an overall less action from citizens in regard to basic services like education and health. Even if this can not be attribute to Twaweza, it is clear that the overambitious outcomes from the onset of the programme, creating a massive citizen agency movement, has not happend. However, in terms of targetted outreach and influence the Twaweza intervention must be assessed as reaching good results. The media collaborations has exposed 25 per cent of the population with Twaweza messages, Uwezo testing of childrens learning in schools has revealed major problems in the education systemn and has had big policy impact on the sector as has the experimenting with capitation grants and incentives seeking and the mobile phone suvey has exposed policy makers to people´s views on topical issues.
